Doubling the first and tripling the second gives 8x + 6y = 24 and 15x − 6y = 33, so 23x = 57, x = 57/23 ≈ 2.478, and y = (12 − 4x)/3 = 16/23 ≈ 0.696. So x + y = 73/23 ≈ 3.17. The option "29" writes the first condition as A − 7 = B, forgetting that Ben gains the 7. The option "33" writes the second condition as A + 5 = 2B, forgetting that Ben loses the 5. The option "23" writes the second condition as A + 5 = 2(B + 5), adding the 5 to Ben's count too.

distractor_kind.33: error path: second transfer counted on one side only. (a) above 19. (b) not an extreme. (c) no estimate. (d) real.
